name: Asana
description: Projects, tasks and their status in the Asana workspace you sign in to.
long_description:
Asana's own hosted server. It lists projects, reads a task with its subtasks and comments, creates tasks and moves them along.

You sign in through Asana in your browser. Completing or creating a task is something your team sees, so it follows the chat's permission mode.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Asana in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reaches the Asana workspace you sign in to. Creating or completing a task changes what your team sees.
